## Community composition

Each site and study visit is tested separately. Relative read counts define Bray–Curtis dissimilarities. The pig is the experimental unit.

```{r}
#| label: community-tests
df_samples <- read_input("samples") %>% mutate(Diet = factor(Diet, levels = diet_levels))
mat_count <- readRDS(path_source("00-raw", "counts.rds"))
stopifnot(nrow(df_samples) == 73L, nrow(mat_count) == 16934L,
          identical(colnames(mat_count), df_samples$sample_id))
df_strata <- data.frame(Location = c("fecal", "fecal", "fecal", "cecum", "colon"),
                       Month_raw = c("Aug", "Sep", "Dec", "Dec", "Dec"))
use_permutation_state(states, "community")
df_community <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_strata)), function(i) {
  df <- filter(df_samples, Location == df_strata$Location[i], Month_raw == df_strata$Month_raw[i])
  cbind(df_strata[i, ], test_community_groups(mat_count[, df$sample_id, drop = FALSE], df, nperm = 19999L))
}))
knitr::kable(df_community, digits = 5)
```

## Within-pig changes and ordination

The paired comparison uses month-7 minus month-4 Hellinger composition in 13 pigs. The endpoint PCoA uses the Lingoes correction.

```{r}
#| label: paired-and-ordination
df_fecal <- filter(df_samples, Location == "fecal")
df_endpoint <- filter(df_fecal, Month_raw == "Dec")
complete_pigs <- df_fecal %>% count(host_id) %>% filter(n == 3) %>% pull(host_id)
df_paired <- filter(df_endpoint, host_id %in% complete_pigs)
prior_ids <- df_fecal$sample_id[match(paste(df_paired$host_id, "Sep"), paste(df_fecal$host_id, df_fecal$Month_raw))]
mat_relative <- make_relative_abundance(mat_count)
mat_delta <- t(sqrt(mat_relative[, df_paired$sample_id]) - sqrt(mat_relative[, prior_ids]))
rownames(mat_delta) <- df_paired$host_id
use_permutation_state(states, "paired_change")
fit_delta <- vegan::adonis2(stats::dist(mat_delta) ~ Diet, data = df_paired, permutations = 19999L)
df_paired_test <- data.frame(n = nrow(df_paired), r_squared = fit_delta$R2[1],
                            pseudo_f = fit_delta$F[1], p_perm = fit_delta$`Pr(>F)`[1])
distance <- vegan::vegdist(t(mat_relative[, df_endpoint$sample_id]), method = "bray")
fit_pcoa <- vegan::wcmdscale(distance, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = "lingoes")
explained <- 100 * fit_pcoa$eig[1:2] / sum(fit_pcoa$eig)
df_ordination <- mutate(df_endpoint, PCoA1 = fit_pcoa$points[, 1], PCoA2 = fit_pcoa$points[, 2],
                       axis1_percent = explained[1], axis2_percent = explained[2])
knitr::kable(df_paired_test, digits = 5)
```

## Pairwise endpoint diet contrasts

Each comparison subsets the endpoint Bray-Curtis distance matrix and uses 9,999 permutations. BH correction covers the three comparisons reported in the supplementary methods.

```{r}
#| label: pairwise-community
df_pairwise <- bind_rows(lapply(combn(diet_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(pair) {
  df <- filter(df_endpoint, Diet %in% pair) %>% mutate(Diet = droplevels(Diet))
  indices <- match(df$sample_id, df_endpoint$sample_id)
  dissimilarity <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance)[indices, indices])
  set.seed(20260919)
  fit <- vegan::adonis2(dissimilarity ~ Diet, data = df, permutations = 9999L)
  data.frame(contrast = paste(pair, collapse = " vs "), n = nrow(df), r_squared = fit$R2[1],
             pseudo_f = fit$F[1], p_perm = fit$`Pr(>F)`[1], nperm = 9999L)
})) %>% mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_perm, "BH"))
knitr::kable(df_pairwise, digits = 5)
```

## Litter-restricted tests

Exact label enumeration preserves diet counts within each litter. The endpoint test includes 14 pigs with known litter; the paired test treats the pig with unknown litter as a fixed singleton.

```{r}
#| label: litter-tests
exact_test <- function(df, distance, scenario, analysis) {
  labels <- enumerate_litter_labels(as.character(df$Diet), df$block)
  fit <- vegan::adonis2(distance ~ Diet, data = df, permutations = 0)
  null_f <- apply(labels, 1, function(lab) vegan::adonis2(distance ~ Diet,
    data = data.frame(Diet = factor(lab)), permutations = 0)$F[1])
  tail <- sum(null_f >= fit$F[1] - 1e-12)
  data.frame(analysis, scenario, n = nrow(df), n_blocks = n_distinct(df$block),
             n_assignments = nrow(labels), tail_count = tail, p_min = 1 / nrow(labels),
             r_squared = fit$R2[1], pseudo_f = fit$F[1], p_exact = tail / nrow(labels))
}
df_known <- filter(df_endpoint, !is.na(gp_litter)) %>% mutate(block = gp_litter) %>% arrange(host_id)
df_paired <- df_paired %>% mutate(block = ifelse(is.na(gp_litter), paste0("unknown_", host_id), gp_litter)) %>% arrange(host_id)
df_litter <- bind_rows(
  exact_test(df_known, vegan::vegdist(t(mat_relative[, df_known$sample_id]), method = "bray"), "known_litter_only", "endpoint_fecal"),
  exact_test(df_paired, stats::dist(mat_delta[df_paired$host_id, , drop = FALSE]), "unknown_singletons", "paired_change"))
knitr::kable(df_litter, digits = 5)
saveRDS(list(community = df_community, paired_change = df_paired_test,
             ordination = df_ordination, litter = df_litter,
             pairwise = df_pairwise), path_target("community_results.rds"))
```
